definitions.returned: 0 is outer callback failure; 1 is success.
definitions.claimed: Retained private packet ownership count after this callback.
definitions.population: Count of set ownership bits after this callback.
definitions.ready_one_stores: Observed native writes of value 1 to selected readiness flag.
definitions.release_requests: Observed writes to original lock28 release MMIO 0x1ec03270, not a physical release proof.

injections.denied: Original lock28 acquire reads modeled denial; native acquire return is nonzero.
injections.claim_fault: Fault latched at the committed count store, before native head publication.
injections.release_fault: Barrier fault injected upon original packet lock release, after claim/publication.
injections.head_changed: External head changed to 37 at committed count store; initial head was zero.
injections.lock_changed_after_grant: Public lock ID at 0x3e901b9c changed from 28 to 27 after acquire, before packet_take.

scope: Original RX/lock instructions with retained cold packet claims; explicit modeled grant/storage and held lease.
No hot release/recycle,real loader/vendor-blob installation,physical backing/coherency/drain or client proof.
Full strict setup is still denied; other packet users retain the existing TXDONE route.

denied_lock.instructions: Using controls.denied and definitions, is the modeled denied acquisition rejected without packet claim, descriptor, readiness-one write or lock28 release request?

late_retention.instructions: Using controls.claim-fault and controls.release-fault plus their injections, do the committed claims remain owned after the fault? This asks about retained ownership, not physical DMA containment.

late_exposure.instructions: Using controls.claim-fault and controls.release-fault and definitions, is native descriptor/readiness exposure denied for those late-fault callbacks?

snapshot.instructions: Does controls.head-changed show retention of the private claim while the externally changed head stays 37 rather than being silently repaired?

private_release.instructions: Do controls.lock-changed-after-grant, injections.lock_changed_after_grant, private_release_source and mutable_release_mutant support constant lock28 release identity despite the public lock field changing?

physical_scope.instructions: Does scope establish physical DMA ownership, drains and client acceptance for the complete W1700K NPU?
